integrity: Exact infinite-dimensional analytical proof; finite-volume numerical checks are corroborative, not a replacement. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar equal-mass square lattices with finite positive foundation pins; modes strictly above band, not edge resonances. Literature priority remains provisional, especially potential unstated coverage by general finite-rank bound-state index theorems.
title: Resistance-controlled count of localized modes in finitely pinned square lattices
